description: Defines the CommentLazyBuilders class for comment lazy builder callbacks in Drupal, including methods for rendering comment forms and links, and managing comment-related actions.

classes.name: CommentLazyBuilders
classes.description: Provides lazy builder callbacks for comments, including rendering forms and links, and handling comment actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting necessary services for comment lazy builder operations.

methods.name: renderForm
methods.description: Builds and returns a renderable comment form for a specific entity and field.

methods.name: renderLinks
methods.description: Builds and returns a renderable array of comment links (reply, edit, delete, etc.) for a specific comment entity.

methods.name: buildLinks
methods.description: Constructs default action links (reply, edit, delete, approve) for a comment.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks access permissions for content translation.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback methods trusted for lazy rendering.
